title: The Pullman house's front divided into pavilions
items: 1729 Prairie's front is now divided into bays by banded stone piers, one turning the corner onto 18th Street, with the cornice stepping forward over each. Read off the Detroit Publishing photograph.
A deep frieze with framed panels runs under the cornice, a row of modillions runs round it, and raised ribs divide the mansard over the north bays. The north-west bay has its own dormer.
